review_basis: Final working-tree source hashes below; independently reviewed API/source and callback preservation. Documentation edits only by reviewer.
confirmed: S30 source text sizes/colors, emphasized title appearance and card clearances are restored; the URL spacing false positive is resolved by source nesting: 8dp plus 2dp equals retained 10dp.
S31 filter headings and reviewed firewall container/group insets match source attributes; S32 labels and one-line ellipsis preserve selection and callbacks.
S33 heading appearance, title/subtitle/empty font sizes, selected title behavior, centered header row and empty text alignment match the reviewed source contracts.
Both field overloads wrap the existing BasicTextField without substituting value callbacks, KeyboardActions, focus callbacks or keyboard options.

The search interceptor invokes the underlying request once per connection request and returns the same InputConnection. It changes only the autocomplete/no-suggestions/autocorrect hint mask; session cancellation and all other EditorInfo metadata remain with Compose.
Non-search fields and explicitly enabled autocorrection bypass the interceptor; non-text classes and all three password variations keep their inputType unchanged.

resolved_review_findings.issue: Centered empty text had wrap-content width.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: The empty Text now fills the parent width before its source padding and TextAlign.Center.

resolved_review_findings.issue: FlowRow top-aligned and could wrap the subtitle, unlike the source RelativeLayout.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: A vertically centered Row reserves the subtitle width; title and selectable title wrapper use weight(1f). Selection remains intact.

resolved_review_findings.issue: All firewall groups shared one inset despite different source parent/group margins and padding.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Parent group has horizontal 10dp, top 5dp, bottom 2dp. Category/sort groups have combined horizontal 12dp and vertical 7dp.

official_evidence.finding: Public interceptor forwards a request through the existing cancellable input session.
Android request is a public fun interface returning InputConnection from EditorInfo.
Legacy BasicTextField adapter forwards its request through startInputMethod and returns its own recording connection.
Public API reference records introduction in Compose 1.7.0, before the configured 2026.08.00 BOM.

limits: Source-only approval for the bounded changes, not whole-layout or pixel-equivalence clearance.
